artifact.the-great-expansion.runeOfIndom:

Stack equipped with this artifact has Unlimited Retaliation and regenerates 75 Health at the start of each of its turns.
You help a runesmith by securing a cargo of ore. For this help, he rewards you with a magic rune.
artifact.the-great-expansion.runeOfTheEa:
{Rune of the Earthlord}

Stack equipped with this artifact gains 3 Defense, Immunity to level 1-3 spells and receives 30% less damage from melee attacks.
You help a runesmith by securing a cargo of ore. For this help, he rewards you with a magic rune.
artifact.the-great-expansion.runeOfTheSk:
{Rune of the Skylord}

Stack equipped with this artifact gains 1 Luck, 3 Speed, 3 Attack, receives 30% less damage from ranged attacks, can retaliate an additional 1 time per round and has 20% chance to deflect hostile spell at a random enemy stack.
You help a runesmith by securing a cargo of ore. For this help, he rewards you with a magic rune.
artifact.the-great-expansion.runeOfWater:
{Rune of Water Immunity}

Stack equipped with this artifact is immune to all water spells.
You help a runesmith by securing a cargo of ore. For this help, he rewards you with a magic rune.
artifact.the-great-expansion.sapphirePen:
{Sapphire Pendant}

Grants immunity to Weakness spell to all units in the hero's army and grants your tier 5 units +5 Max Health and 75 Health per turn Regeneration.
You find a pendant lying next to a skeleton. You pick it up.
artifact.the-great-expansion.scarabOfFor:
{Scarab of Fortitude}

Reduces damage received by your army from physical attacks by 40%.

You find a stray cat playing with something and making a lot of noise. Surprised, you find out that the toy was actually a Scarab of Fortitude. You take both the cat and the artifact, taking a proper care of both of them.
artifact.the-great-expansion.shieldOfRet:
{Shield of Retribution}

Increases Attack and Defense of the hero by 4 and grants an additional retaliation strike to creatures in the hero's army.
After a drunked dwarf accidentally pushes you in a tavern, causing you to spill your beer, you are awarded with Shield of Retribution to even the loss.
artifact.the-great-expansion.shieldOfThe:
{Shield of the Jotunns}

Increases Defense of the hero by 7 and grants the units in the hero's army immunity to Berserk.
Traversing through the cold mountains, you finally find the object of your search: the Shield of the Jotunns.
artifact.the-great-expansion.shiverCloak:
{Shiver Cloak}

Increases the hero's Knowledge by 1 and reduces Speed of all units on the battlefield by 1.
You bought a good-looking cloak at a local tailor. Unfortunately, it doesn't look like it makes you feel warmer at all
artifact.the-great-expansion.silverMedal:
{Silver Medal}

Stack equipped with this artifact has a bonus of +1 to Attack, +1 to Defense, +1 to Max Health and +2 to Speed.
You take part in a local sprinting competition and end up winning the second place.
artifact.the-great-expansion.sirensConch:
{Siren's Conch}

Grants immunity to Hypnotize spell to all units in the hero's army and grants your tier 4 units Hypnotizing attack.
You walk through a shore and find a peculiar shell.
artifact.the-great-expansion.sniperEyepa:
{Sniper's Eyepatch}

Stack equipped with this artifact has a bonus of +30% to ranged damage dealt and ignores any range penalty it would have.

During your journey, you happen to a marksmanship tournament and decide to try your luck. You manage to score the first place, beating the crowd's favourite. Furious, he throws his eyepatch onto the ground and storms away. You pick it up as a good luck charm.
artifact.the-great-expansion.sorcerersRi:
{Sorcerer's Ring}

Increases damage dealt with spells by 20%.

During your travels, a mad mage picks a fight with you and starts casting multiple fireballs at you. A single lightning bolt from your fingers zaps the mage to a crisp, leaving only dust and a magic ring.
artifact.the-great-expansion.soulscarRin:
{Soulscar Ring}

Increases all of the hero's primary skills by 1, but reduces Luck by 1.

During your travels, a mad mage picks a fight with you and starts casting multiple fireballs at you. A single lightning bolt from your fingers zaps the mage to a crisp, leaving only dust and a magic ring.
artifact.the-great-expansion.sparklingNe:
{Sparkling Necklace of Charming}

Greatly increases the chance a neutral stack will join the hero's army.

Evil sorceress rules hordes of orcs and attempts to break into a castle. You go straight into her lair and shoot from afar using your trusty crossbow. Once shot, the orcs scatter, as if brainwashed. You slowly walk towards the sorceress and take her necklace.
artifact.the-great-expansion.spellBinder:
{Spellbinder}

Increases Spell Power and Knowledge by 25%.
While taking a rest, a playful fairy comes and wants to play with you. Tired, you attempt to amuse her, but your mood brightens as she hands you Spellbinder as a reward.
artifact.the-great-expansion.stoneheelTo:
{Stoneheel Totem}

At the start of each combat, casts Expert Slow for 3 turns.
You find an ogrish shaman trying to learn new spells. Unsuccessful, he throws a magic totem away, in your direction. You pick it up.
artifact.the-great-expansion.swiftguardH:
{Swiftguard Halberd}

Increases the army's Damage, Health and Speed by 1.

You happen upon an aftermath of a battle. Six warriors defending a single caravan stood against at least four dozens of orcs and ogres. Among the remains you find a fine weapon, which you decide to use.
{Tiger Armor}

Increases the army's Damage by 2.
After battling a frocious white tiger, you make an armor out of its pelt. After donning it, you let a ferocious roar that inspires your soldiers.
artifact.the-great-expansion.tigerHelmet:
{Tiger Helmet}

Stack equipped with this artifact gains 5 Defense, 1 Max Damage and gains First Strike.
After a tough battle with a white tiger, you are rewarded with this nice artifact Use it well.
artifact.the-great-expansion.tombRelic.d:
{Tomb Relic}

Increases Attack and Defense of the hero by 3, but reduces Morale by 1.
artifact.the-great-expansion.tombRelic.e: You found an unguarded tomb. Upon peeking inside, you find an intricate artifact. You decide to take it, but something seems to weight down on you.
artifact.the-great-expansion.tomeOfOmnis:
{Tome of Omniscience}

Allows you to cast all spells on Expert level.
While in a tavern, you notice that one leg of the chair you are sitting on is shorter than the rest, and there's a book underneath it. Turns out it was a Tome of Omniscience.
artifact.the-great-expansion.treadsOfEnl:
{Treads of Enlightenment}

Increases Speed of units in the hero's army by 1 and increases experience gained by the hero by 20%.
You rest in a library to find that someone forgot to take their Treads of Enlightenment. Not wanting to leave this artifact there, you put it on and leave.
artifact.the-great-expansion.turbanOfEnl:
{Turban of Enlightenment}

Increases Knowledge of the hero by 3 and causes them to receive an additional 10% Experience from all sources.
You rest in a library to find that someone forgot to take their Turban of Enlightenment. Not wanting to leave this artifact there, you put it on and leave.
artifact.the-great-expansion.unicornHorn:
{Unicorn Horn}

Stack equipped with this artifact has a bonus of +2 to Max Health, +1 to Speed, gains 20% Spell Resistance and has a 20% chance to cast Expert Blind on the target.
Passing through a peaceful meadow, you happen upon two mating unicorns. Trying to move as far away as possible from this sight, you stumple upon one of the unicorn horns. You keep it.
artifact.the-great-expansion.vampireFang:
{Vampire Fang}

Stack equipped with this artifact becomes Undead, gains 2 Speed and heals for 30% of any damage dealt. This effect can revive dead units in the stack.
After a fight with some vampires, who were more troublesome than difficult, you rip one of their fangs out of anger and put it into your pouch as a trophy.
artifact.the-great-expansion.wailingInfe:
{Wailing Inferno}

Each creature in the enemy hero's army has its Max Health reduced by 2.
During your travels, you hear moans and shrieks of pain and despair nearby, but upon closer inspection it turned out to be just a shield.
artifact.the-great-expansion.wandOfCurse:
{Wand of Curses}

Stack equipped with this artifact has a 30% chance to apply an advanced Curse on attack.

While resting in a village, you happen to a child that's waving a black stick in front of everyone's faces and shouts "I'm an evil wizard and I'm gonna curse you!". You ask the child to trade his wand for one of your coins, and gain a genuine Wand of Curses.
artifact.the-great-expansion.wandererBoo:
{Wanderer's Boots}

Increases the amount of Movement Points on land and sea by 600.
You meet up a traveller, who says that he was wandering too much in his life and needs to settle down. He then hands his boots.
artifact.the-great-expansion.warlocksSku:
{Warlock's Skull}

Increases Spellpower and Knowledge of the hero by 3, but reduces Morale by 1.
During your travels, you notice a heretic that just finished cleaning and preparing a skull of a warlock. You take the evil man down, but also take the skull, otherwise it would all go to waste.
artifact.the-great-expansion.warriorRing:
{Warrior's Ring}

Increases damage dealt by melee units in the hero's army by 10%.
You are a witness of a warrior fighting a gorgon. Seeing that he's loosing it, you charge and slay the beast. In gratitude, thewarrior gives you his magic ring.
artifact.the-great-expansion.weldingMask:
{Welding Mask}

Grants an additional shot to controlled Ballista and Catapult.
On your travels, you meet the famous Sir Mullich. You ask him for an autograph. He gives you a Welding Mask instead.
artifact.the-great-expansion.wingedSanda:
{Winged Sandals}

Increases all primary attributes of the hero by 1 and increases Speed of units in the hero's army by 1.
During travels, you feel something falling onto your head. Apparently a cupid that was flying above you lost his sandals.
{Wizard Robe}

Allows the hero to cast all level 1 spells.
During your travels, you notice a peasant wearing a wizard's robe like crazy. You knock him out before he harms anyone, then take off his magic robe.
artifact.the-great-expansion.wolfCharm.d:
{Wolf Charm}

Increases the army's Damage by 1.
artifact.the-great-expansion.wolfCharm.e: After battling a pack of wolves, you rip their teeth and make a talisman out of them.
artifact.the-great-expansion.wolfFang.de:
{Wolf Fang}

Stack equipped with this artifact has its Damage increased by 1.
artifact.the-great-expansion.wolfFang.ev: Feeling like hunting, you decide to go to a nearby forest. After several minutes, you manage to get a nice wolf trophy.
{Wyvern Fang}

Stack equipped with this artifact has its Damage increased by 1-2 and has a 20% chance to inflict Poison.
After a tough fight with a wyvern, you take its fang as a trophy.
hero.the-great-expansion.adhara.biograph: It is told that Adhara can lead the most exotic armies. It is no surprise, considering she was a slave that fought alongside other slaves from multiple factions, and managed to become and overlord.
hero.the-great-expansion.adhara.name: Adhara
hero.the-great-expansion.adhara.specialt: The hero's Morale is increased by 1 every 6 hero levels.
hero.the-great-expansion.aery.biography: Quiet like the still wind, Aery is caring and curious, but as they say, beware the silence before the storm.
hero.the-great-expansion.aery.name: Aery
Air and Storm Elementals in the hero's army gain a bonus of +8 to Max Damage.
hero.the-great-expansion.amani.biography: The Great Teacher Amani is known for surprisingly caring attitude and knowledge of magic. It is no wonder that shamans in her army are able to cast various different spells for different occasions.
hero.the-great-expansion.amani.name: Amani
hero.the-great-expansion.amani.specialty: Ogre Shamans can now cast Advanced Antimagic, Advanced Haste and Advanced Slow. Increases the amount of casts by 1.
hero.the-great-expansion.biri.biography: Biri curses her enemies in a way that her army can operate around her foes easily. Slow like a slug, they are easy pickings for the swamp-dwellers of Tatalia.
hero.the-great-expansion.biri.name: Biri
Enemies affected by Weakness and Poison have their Speed reduced by 2.
hero.the-great-expansion.davin.biography: Davin focuses most of his studies on fighting enemy archers and is a specialist in storm magic. Thanks to it, enemies have trouble shooting, while his archers have no problem while fighting from afar, letting him win any ranged combat he takes part in.
hero.the-great-expansion.davin.name: Davin
hero.the-great-expansion.davin.specialty: Enemy shooting creatures receive a penalty of -10% to damage dealt and -1 to Speed.
hero.the-great-expansion.diev.biography: Diev has been dubbed "Lightning Bolt", because of how she fights- she rains down onto her enemies in a flash, delivering a devastating blow, before killing any survivors. She takes pride in being someone whose ambushes always succeed.
hero.the-great-expansion.diev.name: Diev
Your units receive a bonus of +3 to Attack and Speed during the first round of combat.
hero.the-great-expansion.evelyn.biograph: For decades, griffins were used as mighty beasts that stay in the middle of combat and fight relentlessly. Evelynn focused on their flying properties and taught them how to attack without engaging in prolonged duels. Thanks to this, griffins in her army stay healthy, if somewhat suspicious of the other humans.
hero.the-great-expansion.evelyn.name: Evelyn
hero.the-great-expansion.evelyn.specialt: Griffins and Royal Griffins in the hero's army gain No Enemy Retaliation ability and their Speed and Max Damage increase by 1 every 10 hero levels.
hero.the-great-expansion.forbest.biograp: Forbest is a tricky witch, not afraid to get into melee. By rendering her foes vulnerable, she can deliver a deadly blow. Thanks to this, she can take down the strongest enemies with just a small amount of units.
hero.the-great-expansion.forbest.name: Forbest
hero.the-great-expansion.forbest.special: Enemies affected by Blind receive 75% more damage from attacks.
hero.the-great-expansion.gram.biography: Gram, sometimes called "The Fist of Tatalia" knows how to capture towns fast. For this, he specializes in getting the required resources and focuses on the troops that are the most useful during sieges. Truly, no castle is safe if Gram is nearby.
hero.the-great-expansion.gram.name: Gram
Lizardmen, Serpent Flies, Wyverns and upgrades of those creatures receive a bonus of +1 to speed and damage they receive is reduced by 0.65% per hero level.
hero.the-great-expansion.jevanne.biograp: Jevanne has a deep connection with the trees. Whenever she becomes threatened, she can awaken the treants and send them at surprisingly fast speed.
hero.the-great-expansion.jevanne.name: Jevanne
hero.the-great-expansion.jevanne.special: Dendroid Guards and Dendroid Soldiers gain a bonus of +3 to Speed, but also gain a penalty of -3 to Defense.
hero.the-great-expansion.kaite.biography: Kaite was responsible for training pikemen to guard the king, but once the war in Erathia has begun, she changed the training and took her soldiers to the offensive. Now her pikemen are known for their offensive capabilities.
hero.the-great-expansion.kaite.name: Kaite
hero.the-great-expansion.kaite.specialty: Pikemen and Halberdiers in the hero's army receive a bonus of +1 to their Speed and Damage.
hero.the-great-expansion.karl.biography: Karl is a master of elements, bending them to his will as he wishes. He uses them and discard them as his mood dictates. At it often changes.
hero.the-great-expansion.karl.name: Karl
Air Elementals, Water Elementals, Fire Elementals and Earth Elementals can be freely swapped. Also increases their Speed by 1.
hero.the-great-expansion.koruga.biograph: Koruga has lost one important battle versus a wizard, and dedicated her own life to never make the same mistake. Now her army has increased resistance, and the slowest units move faster so they won't be barraged by enemy spells.
hero.the-great-expansion.koruga.name: Koruga
hero.the-great-expansion.koruga.specialt: Units in the hero's army are immune to level 1 spells. Ogres and Ogre Shamans gain a bonus of +1 to Speed.
hero.the-great-expansion.lilian.biograph: Lilian died in a duel, and promised herself she will never lose again. She started dabbling with curses and learned quite unique ability: her enemies are easier to kill with every curse she inflicts upon them.
hero.the-great-expansion.lilian.name: Lilian
hero.the-great-expansion.lilian.specialt: Enemies receive 10% more damage from attacks for each of the following curses that afflict them: Curse, Weakness, Disrupting Ray, Slow, Venom, Rend, Misfortune, Sorrow.
hero.the-great-expansion.maurice.biograp: Maurice usually works with the young clerics and teaches them the ways. Good at heart, but impatient, the professor forces students to act quickly and believe in their initial instincts rather than overthink what they have to do.
hero.the-great-expansion.maurice.name: Maurice
hero.the-great-expansion.maurice.special: Casts Haste with effect increased by 3 for level 1–4 creatures, by 2 for level 5–6 creatures, and by 1 for level 7 creatures.
hero.the-great-expansion.mayed.biography: Mayed was fascinated with how much power was garnered in a single lightning strike. She promised herself to spend her life researching this natural phenomenon and uses this knowledge not only to fight, but also to help in research.
hero.the-great-expansion.mayed.name: Mayed
hero.the-great-expansion.mayed.specialty: Volt deals 5% more damage every N levels, where N is the level of targeted unit.
hero.the-great-expansion.naubb.biography: Once a lesser demon, now one of the greatest ones, Naubb is sure blessed by tremendous amount of luck. Even if by chance, he survived a lot of battles, and now uses this experience to lead the other demons, sharing his blessing with them.
hero.the-great-expansion.naubb.name: Naubb
hero.the-great-expansion.naubb.specialty: Increases Luck of the hero by 1 per 6 hero levels.
hero.the-great-expansion.neirith.biograp: Where Neirith goes, storm follows. Gaining mastery over lightning, she strikes fast and true all enemies, no matter where they are. Some generals, upon seeing this warlock, run without engaging, before their army is obliterated.
hero.the-great-expansion.neirith.name: Neirith
hero.the-great-expansion.neirith.special: Increases damage dealt by the Electromancy by 5% per hero level.
hero.the-great-expansion.pyraeus.biograp: An efreet who surprisingly keeps away from the usual, lava-filled places and prefers colder places. Some say it's out of jealousy, because he cannot feel the heat on his body. While useful in battle, this specific quirk surely makes his life hard to live.
hero.the-great-expansion.pyraeus.name: Pyraeus
hero.the-great-expansion.pyraeus.special: Increases the effectiveness of Fire Resistance skill by 5% per hero level.
hero.the-great-expansion.qlinn.biography: Qlinn fell in love in the small green creatures the first time she saw them and now takes a good care to keep them healthy. Thanks to this, their attacks are extra powerful.
hero.the-great-expansion.qlinn.name: Qlinn
hero.the-great-expansion.qlinn.specialty: Gremlins and Master Gremlins in the hero's army receive a bonus of +1 to Damage.
hero.the-great-expansion.rindell.biograp: Rindell was abandoned as a child and lived with dwarves for a long time, where she learned the ways of mining gold. After a few years, her immense magic abilities have awakened.
hero.the-great-expansion.rindell.name: Rindell
hero.the-great-expansion.rindell.special: The hero receives +1 Spellpower every 4th level.
hero.the-great-expansion.rubyhexa.biogra: Rubyhexa is a sorceress that is known from her special breed of imps. Although many of them died before she succeeded, now they are flying and biting hard enough that they can pierce even through armor.
hero.the-great-expansion.rubyhexa.name: Rubyhexa
hero.the-great-expansion.rubyhexa.specia: Imps in the hero's army gain Flying, but their Health is reduced by 1. They also gain 1-2 Damage every 20 levels.
hero.the-great-expansion.sapphire.biogra: Sapphire was once an erathian cleric, devout to the cause. Multiple hardships and lack of understanding from everyone around caused her to abandon all she believed in and join the Nighonians in a way to destroy once her kingdom.
hero.the-great-expansion.sapphire.name: Sapphire
hero.the-great-expansion.sapphire.specia: Increases damage dealt by the Smite spell by 7% every N hero levels, where N is the level of target creature.
hero.the-great-expansion.scarla.biograph: Scarla is known for aerial assaults. Not only dragons, but also other winged monstrosities guided by this overlord are hard like rock and strike as hard. She excels at quick fights, leaving her foes overwhelmed and not able to counterattack.
hero.the-great-expansion.scarla.name: Scarla
hero.the-great-expansion.scarla.specialt: Flying creatures in the hero's army receive a bonus of +0.75% per hero level to damage dealt and -0.75% to damage received per hero level.
hero.the-great-expansion.severan.biograp: Severan experimented on the dead for a long time. Not very liked by the comrades-at-work, he prefers to work in solitude and focus on upgrading his creatures through alchemy.
hero.the-great-expansion.severan.name: Severan
hero.the-great-expansion.severan.special: Walking Dead gain +1 Speed, Regeneration and gain 25% chance to strike the enemy with Acid.
hero.the-great-expansion.shavi.biography: Even if dead, Shavi kept her body intact, which lets her play a living one, however those that are close to her feel cold and drained, as if she was stealing life essence of those who are nearby.
hero.the-great-expansion.shavi.name: Shavi
hero.the-great-expansion.shavi.specialty: Increases Max Health of units in the hero's army by 1 per 6 hero levels.
hero.the-great-expansion.shia.biography: Fighting against Shia is like fighting against the earth itself. Some think that she is a druid in exile, and the Krewlodians look at her with suspicion, she claims she is just a regular battle mage that just happens to know earth magic.
hero.the-great-expansion.shia.name: Shia
Casts Expert Land Mine and Expert Quicksand at the start of each combat.
hero.the-great-expansion.sildd.biography: Many heroes tried to defeat Sildd the Witch, but careful dose of curses, jinxes and hexes lets her remain undefeated. Prepared adversaries appear to be lost, discouraged and in general unlucky, while Sildd takes care of their soldiers.
hero.the-great-expansion.sildd.name: Sildd
hero.the-great-expansion.sildd.specialty: Reduces enemy's Morale and Luck by 1.
hero.the-great-expansion.silis.biography: What Silis couldn't find in the forests of AvLee, she found behind the gates of Conflux. the playful sprites she loves to spend time with. If not for the war, she would stay with them until the end of her days.
hero.the-great-expansion.silis.name: Silis
hero.the-great-expansion.silis.specialty: Pixies and Sprites in the hero's army receive a bonus of +1 to Damage and Speed. Pixies also gain the No Retaliation ability.
hero.the-great-expansion.tarq.biography: Tarq is an avid engineer, fascinated with all things mechanical and artificial. He surrounds himself with gremlins who share his passion.
hero.the-great-expansion.tarq.name: Tarq
Repair ability of Gremlins in the hero's army revives an additional 1 Health per Gremlin and can be used once more.
hero.the-great-expansion.tempestus.biogr: Easy to get angry, loud, rapacious - this is who Tempestus is. Beware when he's angry, as he may bladt you with lightning. And he is often angry.
hero.the-great-expansion.tempestus.name: Tempestus
hero.the-great-expansion.tempestus.speci: Air and Storm Elementals in the hero's army gain a bonus of +8 to Max Damage.
hero.the-great-expansion.traugutt.biogra: Traugutt is not like typical knight - he fights only because he musts, and every moment outside of warfare is spent on travelling through the various lands of Antagarich. His knowledge of the land and impatience let his soldiers move more quickly..
hero.the-great-expansion.traugutt.name: Traugutt
hero.the-great-expansion.traugutt.specia: Increases the amount of Movement Points on both land and water by 12.5 per hero level.
hero.the-great-expansion.trest.biography: Trest, a lumbering giant that somehow can still be considered human, never charges into his enemies. He waits patiently and strikes enemies who tire by getting close themselves, deflecting their assault.
hero.the-great-expansion.trest.name: Trest
hero.the-great-expansion.trest.specialty: Whenever a creature takes the Defend action, it gains First Strike and Additional Retaliation abilities.
hero.the-great-expansion.viviann.biograp: Viviann's parents died due to a forest fire. When she had learned the demons were behind the fire, she sworn to kill every one of them until her last breath. Her units share the same fanaticism and strike hard and true, no matter the foe.
hero.the-great-expansion.viviann.name: Viviann
hero.the-great-expansion.viviann.special: Increases Max Damage of all tier 3+ units under the hero's control by 1 per 7 hero levels.
hero.the-great-expansion.willis.biograph: Willis is a master of guerilla tactics. He makes sure he strikes his foes before they are able to hit back, and does it with little to no loses.
hero.the-great-expansion.willis.name: Willis
hero.the-great-expansion.willis.specialt: Your units receive a bonus of +3 to Attack and Speed during the first round of combat.
hero.the-great-expansion.zebeth.biograph: A fierce demon, if a little unstable, Zebeth wants to watch the world burn. The passion is shared by her demons, which results in them acquiring new abilities.
hero.the-great-expansion.zebeth.name: Zebeth
hero.the-great-expansion.zebeth.specialt: Pit Fiends and Pit Lords can now cast Fireball. Increases the amount of casts by 1.
mapObject.the-great-expansion.ancientTea: The ancient teacher has already taught you. He stays silent and unmoving, as if he was just a statue.
A deep voice calls you to listen for a while. After reaching its source, you find a statue of an ancient entity who tells you stories of different worlds.
mapObject.the-great-expansion.bearIdol.b: Increases Movement Points and Damage of units for the next battle.
You channel ancient powers through the nearby idol, bolstering strength of your troops momentarily.
mapObject.the-great-expansion.beastmaste: (Reduces damage received by units in the visiting hero's army permanently)

{Beastmaster's Hut}

The old beastmaster is boasting "They are now better, huh?"

{Beastmaster's Hut}

An old beastmaster hands you a container with bugs:
